text:
Erik Haula is in Los Angeles at 35, the latest stop in a well-traveled career, and his first goal in six games, a one-timer to tie it in Toronto, was a reminder that he can still finish. He has four goals and eight points in 21 games, goals right in line with his chances.

The problem is five on five. The Kings take 41% of the expected goals with him on (expected goals measure the quality of chances), 12 points worse than without him, and Evolving-Hockey had opponents creating more with him on last season than against all but 12% of forwards, with penalties costing him 3.6 goals. He plays a physical game, 42 hits. A seventh-round pick in 2009, he has built an 840-game career. Our range has him around 35 points. On a Kings team trying to fix its finishing, he is depth, not an answer.
